This page represents a growing collection of my interests and how I leverage data to make sense of the world around me. Take a look around and if you're interested in a project or have questions, you can email me at [pezeshka@gmail.com](mailto:pezeshka@gmail.com).

## About

I'm a data analytics professional with a passion for helping organizations make data-driven decisions. I live with my family in the Pioneer Valley of Western Massachusetts. 

### Professional

My work focuses on the full data lifecycle—from collection to interpretation. I help organizations:

* **Understand Existing Data:** By diving deep into current datasets to uncover trends and opportunities.
* **Improve Data Collection:** By building systems that improve how data is collected and measured. 
* **Drive Strategy:** By working collaboratively to define and operationalize goals and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

My experience spans diverse environments, including B2B, academic research, collegiate-level teaching, and small business consulting.

You can find my current résumé [here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1kM9ImNQi08-RJFJR9l2CmvvWIUH6cJAu/view?usp=sharing).

### Personal Life & Hobbies

I'm a happily married husband and father to two amazing daughters. In my free time, I love to play basketball and golf. I also have a penchant for (obsessively) planning our family's financial future, an activity my wife graciously tolerates.

### Community Involvement

I believe in giving back to the local community and currently serve on the board of the [International Language Institute of Massachusetts](https://ili.edu/) as a member of the Finance Committee.
